visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host with dark, styled hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a grey sweater draped over his shoulders, stands in a bright, white studio environment. He holds a black BALMAIN PARIS makeup bag, smiling at the camera. (2) He opens the bag and retrieves a silver Kryolan powder compact, pointing to the product logo while text overlays appear. (3) He uses a white powder puff to apply the product to his forehead and cheeks while looking into the compact's mirror. (4) He presents a thin black Kaibeauty eyebrow pencil and a small black tube of SUQQU eyebrow gel. (5) He uses the pencil to meticulously fill in his eyebrows, holding the compact mirror close to his face. (6) He applies the eyebrow gel with a spoolie brush, showing a close-up of his face and the brow texture. (7) He shows an essence contour palette and a Kaibeauty makeup brush, demonstrating the two shades in the palette. (8) He applies contour powder to his jawline and the bridge of his nose using the brush. (9) He holds up a small silver jar of La Mer lip balm, gesturing towards the brand name. (10) He applies the lip balm to his lips using his index finger, looking directly into the camera. (11) He presents two lipsticks from Laura Mercier and Dolce & Gabbana, holding them side-by-side. (12) He swatches both shades on the back of his hand, which has a small tattoo on the wrist. (13) He applies both lipsticks to his lips, blending them while small variety text and a celebrity photo appear as an inset. (14) He finishes by holding the black BALMAIN bag again, smiling and gesturing for viewers to comment.
